A model and its harness running the agent loop The model asks the harness to search, edit and run the tests. The harness runs each instruction and returns the result. Then the model replies instead of calling a tool. search("dark mode") 3 matches Harness search Model The agent loop

A model’s context window filling across turns Each result the harness returns lands in the model’s context window, which fills from 20 to 96 percent over three turns. On the fourth turn, the result cannot fit. read("app.tsx") + 420 lines Harness read Model 20% A context window filling up

A model compacting the oldest turns of a context window into one summary Messages and tool results fill the context window to 92 percent. The oldest six fly up to a model, which returns one short summary. The summary takes their place after the system prompt, and the window drops to about a third full before new turns arrive. Context window 8% sys Model Compaction within a single run

Three sessions sharing memory Session one saves two skills to memory. Session two loads both before it starts, then saves MEMORY.md. Session three loads all three. Each session's context starts empty, jumps when memory loads, and fills as it works. Memory deploy/SKILL.md review/SKILL.md MEMORY.md Session 1 Context 0% Session 2 Context 0% Session 3 Context 0% Memory carried across sessions

A primary agent dispatches three sub-agents The primary agent writes a plan of three tasks and sends each to its own sub-agent. The sub-agents work in parallel, finish at different times, and send their results back, ticking each task off the plan. Sub-agent 1 Sub-agent 2 Sub-agent 3 Build the API Build the UI Write the tests A primary agent dispatching three sub-agents

A reviewer verifies a sub-agent's work before it reaches the primary agent The primary agent dispatches a task to a sub-agent. The sub-agent's work goes to a reviewer, which sends it back because one test fails. The sub-agent tries again, the reviewer approves, and the work returns to the primary agent. 1 test fails A reviewer checking a sub-agent’s work
